_how: Every difference between prod's and staging's edge functions that we have decided is fine. One exact function per entry, no wildcards. All five fields are required: check, key, reason, added, by. An entry that no longer matches a real difference fails the run.

accepted.reason: The prod ref appears only inside a code comment that records when a column was checked. Nothing calls that address.

The function has prod's URL written into its code instead of reading SUPABASE_URL. On staging it would call prod with staging's key and be refused, so it is broken here but cannot change prod. Proper fix: read the URL from the environment and redeploy on both sides.
